The '''''Vanguard''''' was the prototype of the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] produced by the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, the ship was stolen by the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]] before its first test flight, and she continued to use it throughout her career.
